light_description: Limited Japanese handmade signature pedal developed with downy/unkie guitarist Hiroshi Aoki; combines overdrive and distortion functions and was produced as a 10-unit limited run.
Dual dirt pedal with independent overdrive and distortion sections; later production uses a larger enclosure while retaining the core design lineage.
Two-stage overdrive developed from a special-order project and subsequently productized; documented as a Camuro production pedal.
Camuro preamp-overdrive with integrated FAT booster section; retained as a core dirt catalog product.
Camuro overdrive retained in the builder's documented dirt catalog.
Camuro fuzz/booster retained in the builder's documented dirt catalog; historical material identifies a germanium-transistor version.
Historical Camuro fuzz-booster project associated with Hiroshi Aoki; retained pending a stronger standalone product record and production-status reconciliation.
